title: The Extended Mapping Obscuration to Reionization with ALMA (Ex-MORA) Survey: 5σ Source Catalog and Redshift Distribution
question: What is the prevalence, cumulative number density, redshift distribution, and volume density of heavily dust-obscured, star-forming galaxies at z > 3 selected via a 2 mm blank-field survey in the COSMOS-Web field?

recipe.goal: Concatenate and image the ALMA 2 mm mosaic
recipe.method: Concatenate measurement sets of individual scheduling blocks and image collectively as a mosaic with time-bin averaging
key_parameters: natural weighting, robust = 2, cell size = 0.3'', time bin averaging = 10s

recipe.goal: Extract >= 5 sigma 2 mm sources and quantify completeness, false detection rate, and flux boosting
recipe.method: Identify >= 5 sigma peak pixels using a region grow algorithm; run 100 iterations of beam-convolved Gaussian mock noise maps for false detection rate and 100 iterations of artificial source injection for completeness and flux boosting
assumptions: Sources are unresolved point sources because the synthesized beam (~13 x 11 kpc at z=3) is well beyond the physical extent of dust emission

recipe.goal: Identify multi-wavelength counterparts, extract NIRCam/multi-wavelength photometry, and filter synchrotron-boosted sources
recipe.method: Create 50''x50'' cutouts, generate F444W segmentation maps down to SNR-per-pixel of 3 using photutils inside diver, measure PSF-corrected multi-wavelength fluxes, and extrapolate 1.28 GHz and 3 GHz radio slopes to 2 mm to identify synchrotron-boosted sources
key_parameters: 50'' x 50'' cutouts; segmentation boundary down to SNR-per-pixel of 3 in F444W

recipe.goal: Compile spectroscopic redshifts and derive photometric redshifts via SED fitting
recipe.method: Compile archival spectroscopic redshifts, resolve single-CO-line degeneracies using photo-z PDFs, and fit UV-to-near-IR photometry with BAGPIPES (or adopt COSMOS2020 / CIGALE for 6 outlier sources)
key_parameters: 5 age bins (10, 30, 100, 300, 600 Myr), log U in [-3, -1], Av in [0, 6], M_star in [10^6, 10^13] M_sun, metallicity in [10^-3, 10^0.4]
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with Planck 2020 parameters (H0 = 67.4 km s^-1 Mpc^-1), Chabrier IMF, Calzetti (2000) dust attenuation law

recipe.goal: Derive 2 mm cumulative number densities, redshift CDF, volume densities, and compare with OIR-dark selection techniques
recipe.method: Run 10^3 Monte Carlo realizations sampling source flux densities, contamination, completeness, and redshift PDFs to compute cumulative number counts N(>S), redshift CDF, and volume densities in dz = 1 bins (adding cosmic variance in quadrature), and test radio+OIR-dark and JWST OIR-dark selection criteria
key_parameters: A_eff = 577 arcmin^2; 10^3 Monte Carlo iterations; flux density bins of 100 uJy; redshift bins of dz = 1
assumptions: Cosmic variance calculated using standard assumptions and cookbook from Moster et al. (2011)

score_reason: The ALMA mosaic imaging parameters (natural weighting, robust=2, 0.3'' pixel size, 10s averaging) and 5-sigma source catalog (Table 2) are clearly provided, and number count / volume density methodologies are well described. However, full end-to-end reproduction of the multi-wavelength photometry and photo-z PDFs is blocked by reliance on unpublished software (diver) and unstated multi-wavelength flux tables.
rediscovery_reason: The primary ALMA 2 mm source catalog (37 sources with positions, SNRs, and flux densities) and cumulative number counts depend only on the public ALMA mosaic (2021.1.00225.S + original MORA) and standard CASA imaging + 5-sigma peak finding, making the ALMA catalog and number counts directly reproducible.
